reports.title: Planet Fitness, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: For the year ending December 31, 2026, the Company is updating the following expectations:
•System-wide same club sales growth of approximately 1.5% to 2% (previously approximately 1%)
•New equipment placements of approximately 135 to 140 in franchisee-owned locations (previously 150 to 160)
•System-wide new club openings of approximately 190 to 195 locations, which includes the acquisition of Be-Fit (previously 180 to 190)
